decisions.reason: Certified gasketed plate heat exchangers for HVAC sit at the core of the firm's established know-how, so it can readily interpret market feedback and refine the product through its own R&D and service learning.
The marine box cooler builds on deep existing competence and already shows a strong reported market position in water cooling systems, so dropping it makes little sense.
The marine cooling unit, presented on a page of its own, draws on related marine cooling knowledge and the global service network, which allows the firm to learn from early results and improve it.
The compact oil cooler is a natural extension of existing exchanger engineering, though its lower website prominence suggests a smaller role, so it is kept while monitored.
Finned tubes for air coolers are a component-level product closely tied to the firm's manufacturing and R&D base, which supports continued assimilation and improvement.
Enhanced heat exchanger tubes benefit from in-house R&D and research cooperation on heat transfer, giving the firm the capacity to develop them further.
